The '''Chadra-Fan Lander''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[One Sith]] to transport their acolytes to [[Mala (planet)|Mala]] during the [[Battle of the Floating World]] in [[139 ABY]]. During the fighting, the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Ania Solo]] and her [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] friend [[Sauk]] managed to blow up the landing craft, killing several [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Legacy (2013) 18" />
